_comment: Igris-ai PROJECT harness manifest (FR-136). Declares the 7 core agents whose codex harnesses are mechanically regenerated from their canonical core/agents/<name>.md prompts (TD-021). Core ships only the SCHEMA (core/scripts/cli-adapters/manifest.schema.json); each project ships its own data manifest at its repo root. Canonical is the SOLE source of truth; every target listed here is a GENERATED artifact - editing a target file directly is a process error. Personal/Layer-2 customizations are NOT declared here - they live in an optional gitignored overlay at ~/.igris/registry/harness-manifest.personal.json (FR-139). TD-233: `surfaces.os_identity` declares the orchestrator-identity surface (GAP-3) — the canonical identity block (core/templates/identity.tmpl) region-merged into each harness's natively auto-read PROJECT-ROOT context file (empirically confirmed 2026-06-10: gemini reads GEMINI.md, codex reads AGENTS.md; claude+opencode read CLAUDE.md, which `igris install` already renders whole-file, so they carry no target here). The block lives in THIS project manifest (not surfaces-manifest.json) because its targets are project-root-relative: `igris harness compile`/`check` run from this checkout see it, other projects never do. `version_source` points at the repo-committed cli/package.json so CI and every contributor checkout re-derive identical bytes without a brain install. GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md are GENERATED artifacts (region-merged; user content outside the markers is preserved) - edit core/templates/identity.tmpl, then recompile.
_harnesses_comment: TD-244 (BI-3): per-harness `delegation_model` — the harness-adapter descriptor for the SIXTH surface (delegation mechanism / boot-injection). `native-static` = the harness loads Igris agents statically and a skill delegating via `subagent_type:<agent>` resolves directly (the skill writes only the abstract intent, no recipe needed). `dynamic-define` = the harness cannot load static Igris agents but defines subagents at runtime (e.g. Antigravity `define_subagent`/`invoke_subagent`) → the per-session delegation RECIPE (core/templates/delegation-recipe.tmpl) is region-merged into the harness's natively auto-read identity file (the os_identity surface) so the orchestrator is taught 'read ~/.igris/core/agents/<X>.md → define_subagent → invoke' ONCE at boot, with ZERO per-skill branching. The recipe rides the identity target keyed by `type`: the `gemini` target writes GEMINI.md which Antigravity reads at boot (empirically confirmed 2026-06-21 via the L-711 marker probe) → gemini=dynamic-define so GEMINI.md carries the recipe; the `codex` target writes AGENTS.md (Codex = native-static) so AGENTS.md stays recipe-free. A harness absent from this map defaults to native-static (back-compat: pre-TD-244 manifests project identity-only). This descriptor IS the L-749 native-static/dynamic-define tiering expressed as adapter config.
